name: code-block
title: Code block
description: Code with a title, optional line numbers and a copy button. No highlighter dependency.
htmlExample: <bef-code-block class="w-full max-w-xl" title="app.js" line-numbers :code='"const total = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price, 0);\nconsole.log(`Total: ${total}`);\n"'></bef-code-block>
